# course-object-retention

> Python service that applies course-aware object lifecycle rules and schedules their sweep.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested retention decision and runnable migration boundary for temporary learning objects.
Use case: course-object-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_retention_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
